sourceText: The lawyer listened gloomily; he did not like his friend’s feverish manner. “You seem pretty sure of him,” said he; “and for your sake, I hope you may be right. If it came to a trial, your name might appear.”

TRANSLATION: jan Utason pi sona lawa li kute lon pilin ike. ona li pilin pona ala tan ni: jan pona ona li toki kepeken nasin pi pilin wawa ike. ona li toki e ni: “mi la, sina pilin sona mute e jan ni. tan pona sina la, mi wile e ni: sona sina li ken lon. ijo ni li tawa tomo lawa la, nimi sina li ken kama lon toki.”
